_note: r.164(3)(i): "has claimed any relief of tax under section 159 or deduction of tax under section 160"; (6)(l): "relief of tax under section 159 or deduction of tax under clause (d) of sub-section (1) of the said" — s.160(1) has no clause (d), so (6)(l)'s second limb is W-090c's to read (D-520). s.159: agreements with another country or specified territory for relief of double taxation. Split from UNILATERAL_FOREIGN_TAX_DEDUCTION because they are two facts (D-520). The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (II), "sections 90 or 90A" (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: Are you claiming relief of tax under a double-taxation agreement?
